Problem Statement
Read a person's age and determine whether the person is eligible to vote, using an if-else statement.
Description
A person is eligible to vote if their age is 18 or more. Read an integer age from input and use an if-else statement to print "Eligible" if the age is at least 18, otherwise print "Not Eligible".
Input Description
A single non-negative integer age.
Output Description
Print "Eligible" if age is 18 or more, otherwise print "Not Eligible".
